description: Games Master paid flash mints, read live from the contracts' own clock: the live event (if any), whether a paid flash mint is open now (Black Market crate, Portal disk, Mercenary Market), ETH price, per event cap, how many are left, when the sale closes, and when the next event cannot start before. Event starts are decided by a public draw, so poll this tool. Buy with prepare_gm_flash_mint. Read only, free.
name: gm_flash_info
